people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
translations.bsb: And whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, would be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.
translations.kjv: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
translations.asv: and that whosoever would not seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
